content: Developer sales-ops metrics that operators actually run: sales velocity (units/month), absorption rate (velocity / released inventory), months-to-sellout and unsold overhang, revenue run-rate, average selling price, net realisation after discounts, cancellation rate, collection efficiency/ageing, cost per qualified lead and cost per booking by channel, stage-wise funnel conversion and stage ageing, response-time SLA compliance, site-visit-to-booking ratio, agent/broker conversion and commission. Important caveat repeated across sources: launch-quarter sales inflate lifetime averages (20-40% of inventory can move in launch quarter), so trailing 3-month velocity is the honest number. Lead-to-booking ratios around 1:80 are cited for mass-market projects; luxury preselling behaves differently (longer nurture, referral-heavy, 15-25% referral conversion vs 1-4% internet leads).
